questionText: As an Advanced Accounting Analytics intern at Gringotts Bank, you are tasked with investigating factors that explain variation in account balances accrued by credit card holders. The credit.csv file contains a data set with information on 400 credit card account holders, including the following variables: Balance: credit card balance, i.e. debt owed to bank ($ dollars) Income: cardholder annual income ($ thousands of dollars) Limit: credit spending limit ($ dollars) Student: Yes/No indicator for whether or not the cardholder is a part-time or full-time student Fit a linear regression model for Balance in terms of the following predictors: Income Student Limit the interaction between Student and Limit Which of the following is an accurate interpretation of the results of this model? Select TRUE below for accurate interpretations or FALSE for inaccurate interpretations.

blanks.label: For cardholders who are students, we estimate a balance increase of approximately $0.27 for every one-dollar increase in credit limit (when comparing cardholders with the same income level).
For cardholders with the same student status and credit limit, we are 95% confident that an increase in annual Income is associated with a decrease in credit card Balance.
For cardholders who are students, relative to non-students, we estimate a balance decrease of $144 (adjusting for annual income and credit limit).
For cardholders who are students, we estimate a balance increase of approximately $275 for every one-dollar increase in credit limit (when comparing cardholders with the same income level).

name: multiple_answers: Which of the following statements is true of "colliders"…
questionText: Which of the following statements is true of "colliders" in the context of regression modeling? Select all correct answers.

choices.label: A
choices.text: "Collider" is just another synonym for a confounder.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Confounders tend to be causally "upstream" of X and Y, while colliders are causally "downstream" of X and Y.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Exploratory data analysis (like plots and simple model fits) will help you tell the difference between a confounder and a collider.

choices.label: D
choices.text: If our goal is to isolate a partial relationship between X and Y, confounders and colliders must both be included in our regression model.

choices.label: E
choices.text: If our goal is to isolate a partial relationship between X and Y, confounders should be included in the model, while colliders should be excluded.

questionText: As an Advanced Accounting Analytics intern at Gringotts Bank, you are tasked with investigating factors that explain variation in credit card account balances. questionText: Next semester, your work-study position involves data science support for a visiting scholar interested in dragon demography. You help them to fit a linear model using the dragons.csv file, a data frame on 2000 magnificent beasts randomly sampled from the extensive Care of Magical Creatures database including the following variables: lifespan -- age of dragon in years color -- color of dragon (black, blue, green, red) spikes -- indicator for spikes on body or tail (spikes, without) lost_teeth -- number of lost teeth scars -- number of scars height -- in yards weight -- in tons Fit a linear model predicting lifespan in terms of the variables for spikes, scars, lost teeth, and color. Which of the following conclusions is accurate for the results of this regression model? Evaluate each statement below as TRUE or FALSE.

blanks.label: The model suggests that a black dragon with spikes who has no lost teeth or scars will live for at most 613 years, with 95% confidence.
Adjusting for spikes, scars, and teeth, black dragons have (on average) the shortest lifespan relative to dragons of other colors.
For each additional lost tooth, we expect green dragons to live for almost 2 years more, on average (adjusting for scars and spikes).
The increase in lifespan associated with an additional scar is approximately 40 years, holding constant other model predictors.
We are 95% confident that red dragons will live at least 5 fewer years on average relative to dragons of all other colors.

name: multiple_answers: In 1990, the United Nations created a single measure…
questionText: In 1990, the United Nations created a single measure that ranges between zero and one -- the Human Development Index (HDI) -- to summarize health, education, and economic status for world countries. Below is the equation for a fitted model to predict response variable HDI in terms of two predictor variables: Life expectancy and average years of School. HDI = -0.34 + (0.01 * Life) + (0.02 * School) + E Which of the following is an accurate interpretation of the coefficient for years of School? Select all correct answers.

choices.label: A
choices.text: When the average years of School in a country increases by one year, we expect HDI to increase by 0.02, irrespective of variation in Life expectancy.

choices.label: B
choices.text: We expect HDI to increase by 0.02 for every one-year increase in the School variable, after adjusting for the simultaneous effect of Life expectancy on HDI.

choices.label: C
choices.text: When comparing countries with similar life expectancies but a difference of one year in years of School, we'd expect their HDIs to differ by 0.02.

choices.label: D
choices.text: An estimated slope for the overall relationship between years of School and HDI.

questionText: A social media influencer wants to understand the relationship between the length of each video they post and the number of viewers who watch the video in its entirety. They decide to build a model to predict Viewers (total numbers of viewers who watch each entire video) from Length of video (in seconds). choices.label: A

choices.label: B
